package.description: Manage local account passwords of domain joined computers

en-US.description: Manage local account passwords of domain joined computers
en-US.longDescription: The "Local Administrator Password Solution" (LAPS) provides management of local account passwords of domain joined computers. Passwords are stored in Active Directory (AD) and protected by ACL, so only eligible users can read it or request its reset.
en-US.name: Local Administrator Password Solution

zh-CN.description: 管理已加入域的计算机的本地帐户密码
zh-CN.longDescription: “Local Administrator Password Solution” (LAPS) 用于管理已加入域的计算机的本地账户密码。密码存储在 Active Directory（AD）中，并由 ACL 进行保护，因此只有符合资格的用户才能读取密码或请求重置。
